insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes through the orderUpdate GraphQL mutation. This change affects unfulfilled orders and applies to the GraphQL Admin API. The tax recalculation occurs against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their apps to account for the tax recalculation when changing the shipping address of an unfulfilled order. This can be achieved by using the orderUpdate mutation and verifying the tax calculations. Additionally, developers should review their existing order update logic to ensure compatibility with this change. The orderUpdate mutation is part of the GraphQL Admin API, which is used in conjunction with other APIs such as the Storefront API and Shopify Functions.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when updating the shipping address of an unfulfilled order, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and reducing potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures compliance with tax regulations, which is essential for merchants and developers alike. It also highlights the importance of staying up-to-date with API changes and updates.
